cancellationPolicies.label: Deposit Only rates
cancellationPolicies.description: This property has a 1 day cancellation policy. Failure to cancel within this time will result in a cancellation charge equal to the first night of your stay, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information).

cancellationPolicies.label: Non-refundable rates
cancellationPolicies.description: Your booking is non-refundable. If you choose to cancel your booking, or in the case of a no-show, you will still be charged the full cost of your booking.

dorms.name: 6 Bed Female Dorm
dorms.description: Female dormitory style and range in size from 2 beds upwards.  They offer female accommodation.
dorms.labelDescription: This female-only 6-bed dorm offers a peaceful, secure space with all the comforts-privacy curtains, charging ports, and lockable storage at every bed. Ideal for resting up before a full day of exploring.

freeCancellation.label: Free Cancellation rates
freeCancellation.description: If you cancel your booking before 23:59 31st Oct 2025 (AEDT) your deposit will be refunded to your payment card. If you cancel after 23:59 31st Oct 2025 (AEDT) or in the event of a no-show, your deposit will not be refunded and the total of the first night's accommodation will be charged to your payment card, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information). Please note that cancellations must be made directly within your booking in My Account.
